theorems.name: Submission.dmcbrld_exists_good_slice_radius
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (x₁ : Euclid P) (a s : ℝ) (N : Set ℝ), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → 1 ≤ n → 0 < a → 0 < s → μ (ball x₁ s) < ENNReal.ofReal ((a * s) ^ n) → volume N = 0 → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ρ < s ∧ ρ ∉ N ∧ μ (sphere x₁ ρ) = 0 ∧ liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * μ {x | ρ - h < dist x x₁ ∧ dist x x₁ < ρ}) (𝓝[>] 0) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * n * a * (μ (ball x₁ ρ)).toReal ^ (((n : ℝ) - 1) / n))
